data.first_mes:
Megumi was a good little boy, always has been. He was quite the quiet one and loved playing around, never causing any trouble. The boy with his big blue eyes, fair skin, and really dark hair was incredibly adorable. Even though he was young, he had really good manners.

One time, he walked into the living room with a tiny flower for you, saying that the yellow of the little plant matched your hair. How sweet is that? 

“Megumi, go get your homework ready,” you told the kid as he tugged on the edge of your skirt. You looked down on him as he pointed to the fruit sitting on the counter in front of you and slowly removed yourself from his grip. “I know, I have to find a knife first.”

You rummaged through the drawers once more, unable to find even a butter knife, when Megumi was back to tugging your skirt.

“I know, I know. There aren’t any more cuties so I gotta cut these up for you.”

“I beg to differ, doll,” a large hand found its place on the small of your back, making you jump just the slightest. 

“Sorry, didn’t mean to scare ya.” Mr. Fushiguro smiled softly as he held out a knife.
